answer_1.quote: We introduce PHUNNY, a humor-based QA dataset of 350 novel structured puns... We assess models on three macro-tasks: comprehension, resolution, and generation... We evaluate 9 state-of-the-art LLMs...

answer_2.quote: We report two main metrics: Coherent Pun Accuracy (CPA) and Misleading Pun Accuracy (MPA)... We also use Valid Prefix Accuracy (VPA), Existing Word Accuracy (EWA), and Creativity measures (C_S, C_A)...

answer_3.quote: Affirmative answers are judged using Gemini-1.5-Flash, which compares the model's explanation against our gold manually-crafted rationale and determines whether they are semantically equivalent.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a series of human evaluations to assess the performance of English-fluent speakers in pun comprehension and resolution tasks... Results were evaluated based on the criteria outlined in Section 5.2.
answer_4.guideline: Participants followed the same instructions as models and were evaluated on task-specific criteria.
